Button.summary: The action control: `brand` for the action, `neutral` beside it, `danger` for a destructive one, `ghost` and `danger-text` for quiet actions in a row.

Input.summary: The quiet text field: a soft fill at rest and a hairline ring on focus, forwarding every native input prop.

Textarea.summary: The multi-line sibling of Input, with relaxed line height and no resize handle.

Select.summary: The native select, one size everywhere (40px tall), with the chevron glyph.

Checkbox.summary: The platform checkbox painted in the accent, with checked, indeterminate, disabled and invalid states and an optional label.

Toggle.summary: The on/off switch (40×24), with an optional label; it sits in a section's header, not on a row of its own.

SearchInput.summary: A search field with a leading icon and a clear button, in three sizes.

Field.summary: A label, a hint and an error around any form control.

Modal.summary: The dialog shell: title, body and footer, closed by Escape or the backdrop, portalled to the page.

ConfirmDialog.summary: A small modal that asks before an action, with a destructive variant and optional type-to-confirm.

ToastHost.summary: The bottom-right stack of toasts from `useToasts()`; errors stay until dismissed, the rest go after six seconds.

SearchMenuInput.summary: The type-to-filter field at the top of a search menu.

SearchMenuList.summary: The scrolling list of a search menu's rows, keeping the active row in view.

SearchMenuEmpty.summary: The one muted line a search menu shows when nothing matches.

Tabs.summary: A row of words with an accent underline that slides to the active tab.

Chip.summary: The one label shape (types, aliases, tags, statuses) in solid, muted or dashed tone; Visvine has no Badge.

Avatar.summary: A person's or space's picture, falling back to a silhouette, initials or the space glyph on an accent tile.

PersonSilhouette.summary: The white person glyph on a colour fill that stands in for a missing photo.

TypeSilhouette.summary: The white glyph of a node type on its type colour, standing in for a missing image.

Alert.summary: A notice in the flow of the page: one line in its status colour with a 2px rule, and an optional dismiss.

Logo.summary: The Visvine logo as SVG: the green `mark`, or the white-on-green `tile` that is the app icon.

EmptyState.summary: One muted line for a surface that is empty as a whole, with an optional action.

PageError.summary: One line saying something did not load, with Retry where trying again could work.

Skeleton.summary: A pulsing placeholder block; compose several in the shape of what is loading.

ContentReveal.summary: Holds a view hidden until its data has loaded, then fades it in.

Stack.summary: Children one under another, a spacing step apart.

Row.summary: Children side by side, a spacing step apart, centred on one line by default.

SettingsSection.summary: A hairline-separated section with its title, and its switch or action in the header.

IconBase.summary: The 24px stroke SVG frame every UI glyph is drawn in; it inherits `currentColor`.

UIProvider.summary: Hands the app's own link and image components to every component that links or draws an image; without it they are a plain `` and ``.
